title: Find and cite official Census district population

messages.text: find official govt data online for 2011 total population of patna gaya and nalanda districts in bihar. make simple website to compare them. show exact source link and census year. dont use blogs
which is largest and what is exact difference between patna and gaya

download table with district exact population census year and source url
